title: Snowdrop
body:
"Snowdrop is a delicate white flower that blooms in early spring, symbolizing hope and renewal"

The Snowdrop is a sellable flower that can be found throughout the entire Snowlands.

It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 200$ per snowdrop. It can also be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the snowdrop fills the composter by approximately 6%
